razonamiento: The architecture represents Sanofi's Data Analytics Portal on AWS. CloudFormation was mentioned as an underlying deployment mechanism of Service Catalog rather than a direct interactive runtime node, so per Rule 7 it was omitted. The user icon was assigned to UserCompanyAnalyst as the internal users accessing analytics tools. RStudio and Sanofi SSO are external/third-party components. Bidirectional lines in the visual reading are represented as reciprocal edges, and the spoken data extraction between users and the Data Lake was incorporated as an edge.
nombre: Sanofi Self-Service Data Analytics Portal Architecture

edges.notes: Users access web portal via CloudFront
edges.respaldo: line b1->b2 and 'il y a un portail web auquel les utilisateurs ont accès.'

edges.notes: CloudFront serves web content to users
CloudFront fetches web assets from S3
S3 returns web assets to CloudFront
Portal delegates auth to Cognito
Cognito returns auth token to web app
Cognito federates authentication to Sanofi SSO
edges.respaldo: line b3->b0 and 'identifié nos utilisateurs avec Cognito et le SSO de Sanofi.'

edges.notes: Sanofi SSO validates credentials to Cognito
edges.respaldo: line b0->b3 and 'identifié nos utilisateurs avec Cognito et le SSO de Sanofi.'

edges.notes: Web portal calls API Gateway endpoints
API Gateway returns API response to portal
API Gateway reads/writes portal metadata in DynamoDB
edges.respaldo: line b5->b6 and 'implémentées avec API Gateway et DynamoDB.'

edges.notes: DynamoDB returns data to API Gateway
Portal requests product portfolio from Service Catalog
edges.respaldo: line b4->b7 and 'vous faites appel à Service Catalog pour avoir un portfolio de produits'

edges.notes: Service Catalog returns available products to portal
Service Catalog provisions SageMaker environment
edges.respaldo: line b7->b10 and 'développé ces produits via l'utilisation de Service Catalog.'

edges.notes: Service Catalog provisions RStudio environment
edges.respaldo: line b7->b9 and 'deux produits principalement que sont SageMaker et RStudio.'

edges.notes: Lambda invokes Translate SDK for bulk translation
edges.respaldo: line b8->b11 and 'utilisé directement le SDK via des lambdas afin de traduire'

edges.notes: Translate returns translated text to Lambda
Lambda invokes Comprehend Medical for metadata and entity detection
edges.respaldo: line b8->b12 and 'lambdas qui utilisent le SDK de Comprehend afin d'identifier ces métadonnées.'

edges.notes: Comprehend Medical returns identified entities and metadata
User extracts data directly from the Data Lake
edges.respaldo: On permet à l'utilisateur d'extraire des données dans le Data Lake, dans leur home user, leur bucket S3
